active.signal: Hed/dek pairs must stand alone; translate article-specific frameworks, scales, levels, scores, and shorthand into plain-language significance instead of assuming universal familiarity.
When placing a selected hed/dek pair in a Google Doc, put the bold hed and italic dek on separate paragraphs, followed by one blank paragraph before the article body.
active.scope: Google Doc delivery of Every hed/dek pairs

provisional.signal: For first-person AI-learning essays, test a vivid two-sentence transformation hed with a short, conversational dek that names one concrete mechanism and the broad outcome; avoid procedural laundry lists when the article can supply the detail.
